markdown:
This griffon is aptly named for both its majestic appearance in flight and its increased ferocity over the common griffon. Despite its size, the sheer muscle mass present in this creature makes flight seem effortless, if preposterous. It makes its home among the canopies of the most ancient forests and atop the peaks of the greatest mountains, hunting its prey from above with silent and deadly accuracy. The ascendant griffon prefers to hunt other large creatures within its territory, such as bears, but they will not hesitate to attack smaller prey they perceive as a threat to their territory. Whether an ascendant griffon is a new evolutionary development or a throwback to a more primeval version of the creature is difficult to determine. Further research into these exceptional creatures may provide insight into their origins and perhaps the origins of all griffons. **[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 33 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 31 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 28 [Ascendant Griffon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3287) **Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 157 **Perception** +25; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 120 feet **Languages** **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +23, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +23, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) +25, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +21, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) +22 **Str** +7 **Dex** +6 **Con** +5 **Int** -4 **Wis** +3 **Cha** +7 --- **AC** 30 **Fort** +21 **Ref** +24 **Will** +18 **HP** 210 **Dread Gaze** **Trigger** A creature ends a [move](/Traits.aspx?ID=658) action within 30 feet of the ascendant griffon; **Effect** The ascendant griffon turns its head to stare down the triggering creature, and attempts to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=2395) it. This use of Demoralize has the [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727) trait rather than the [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541) trait, and the griffon does not take a penalty on its check for not sharing a language. --- **Speed** 25 feet, fly 40 feet **Melee** beak +24, **Damage** 4d8+10 piercing **Melee** talon +24, **Damage** 4d6+10 piercing plus [Improved Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=66) **Melee** wing +24 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)), **Damage** 4d6+10 slashing **Ranged** feather +25 ([range 60 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 2d8+10 piercing **Carry Off** An ascendant griffon can [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) at full speed with a creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) in its talons, moving that creature along with it. **Disembowel** **Requirements** The ascendant griffon has a creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) in its talons; **Effect** The griffon makes a beak Strike to rip at the flesh of its prey. If the Strike hits, that creature becomes [drained 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68) (or increases its drained value by 1, to a maximum of 4). **Terrifying Screech** ([Auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [Emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [Fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=68), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) The ascendant griffon unleashes a fearsome cry that strikes terror into its prey. Each creature within 100 feet must attempt a DC 30 Will save. Regardless of the result, creatures are temporarily immune for 1 minute.
**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature is [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76).
**Failure** The creature is frightened 2.
**Critical Failure** The creature is frightened 2 and [fleeing](/Conditions.aspx?ID=74) for 1 round. **Razor-Edged Flight** The ascendant griffon glides violently forward, [Flying](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312)twice. It makes a wing Strike at any point during the movement against up to two different targets; if either of these attacks is a critical hit, the target also takes 2d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29).
name: Ascendant Griffon
